_readme: Footage slots for the Short and the companion. Put official Tesla clips in source/public/footage/ and set `file` (name inside that folder), `in` (seconds into that file), and optionally `cx`/`cy` (0..1 crop centre for the 9:16 fill), `zoom` (>=1) and `audio` (0..1 level for the demo's own sound). A slot with file=null renders as a labelled placeholder and blocks the final render (tools/check_footage.py). Record every clip in footage/CLIP_LEDGER.md.

F1_AIRBORNE.label: Roadster midair
F1_AIRBORNE.want: Car clearly airborne, largest official angle, recognisable at phone size. Frame 0 of the Short and its last shot (loop).

F2_RAMP_CLIMB.label: Climbing the curved ramp
F2_RAMP_CLIMB.want: Car driving up the C-shaped ramp toward the inverted section.

F3_INVERTED.label: Hanging upside down
F3_INVERTED.want: Car stopped upside down on the ramp (Engadget: held for a few seconds). Also used as the match-cut into the suction diagram.

F4_LAUNCH_ROLL.label: Launch and midair roll
F4_LAUNCH_ROLL.want: Second run: leaves the ramp, rotates/rolls upright with thrusters firing.

F5_LANDING.label: Landing
F5_LANDING.want: Touchdown on the pavement after the roll. A 0.5 s strongest moment is replayed near the end.

F6_FIVE_VEHICLES.label: Clearing five Tesla vehicles
F6_FIVE_VEHICLES.want: Thruster hop over Cybercab, Cybertruck, Semi, Model Y, Model 3. If all five are not visible, switch the Short to the 'row of Teslas' pickup (see script).

F7_ACCEL_RUN.label: 0-60 run
F7_ACCEL_RUN.want: Companion only: the acceleration run and Tesla's on-screen 0.81 s result.

F8_OPTIMUS_SEAT.label: Optimus in the driver's seat
F8_OPTIMUS_SEAT.want: Companion only: door opens, Optimus seated (Engadget: only for show).
